note: The EUR and ZAR returns of the MSCI World Index, derived from the stored US-dollar gross returns and the ECB year-end reference rates. The report shows them as "includes the currency move".

returns.source: MSCI World Index gross return in EUR: derived from the US-dollar return and ECB reference rates

source_by_year.2024: DERIVED: MSCI World Index (USD) gross return 19.19% for 2024 (MSCI World Index (USD) factsheet, 31 Aug 2026, gross returns), converted to EUR at the ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates of 2023-12-29 (1 EUR = 1.105 USD) and 2024-12-31 (1 EUR = 1.0389 USD). MSCI does not publish this figure.

MSCI does not publish this figure.
